visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair featuring reddish highlights, wearing a white "haha baby" hoodie, stands outside a yellow-toned building. He points a finger upward and speaks enthusiastically to the camera, then uses a broad arm gesture to beckon the viewer forward into the store. (2) Inside a cavernous, brightly lit furniture showroom with white industrial ceilings and multiple rows of lighting. The man stands with arms wide open to showcase the vast floor space filled with hundreds of sofas, coffee tables, and dining sets in various colors and styles. (3) The man sits on a bench in front of a giant orange gashapon machine decorated with "Onion Man" cartoon graphics. The scene transitions to a close-up of various collaborative merchandise items including mugs, stickers, and keychains spread out on a table. (4) A close-up of a smartphone screen held by the man shows a Google Maps profile for "Chong Yo Furniture" displaying a 4.8-star rating and nearly 20,000 reviews. He looks at the screen with wide, surprised eyes. (5) In the sofa section, the man reclines on a light blue fabric sofa. He holds up a fan of multicolored fabric swatches. A close-up shows a hand pouring clear water from a green bottle onto the gray fabric, followed by a quick wipe to demonstrate its liquid-resistant properties. (6) In the bedroom department, surrounded by various bed frames, the man jumps and falls onto a white mattress with a quilted pattern. He lies on his stomach, resting his chin on his hands, looking directly at the lens with a satisfied expression. (7) In a wardrobe display area, the man interacts with a sleek, dark-framed glass sliding door. He then touches a series of wooden door material samples arranged like books on a shelf, showcasing different textures from light oak to dark walnut. (8) Back at the prize machine, the man turns a large white handle. A pink plastic capsule falls into the tray, which he picks up. He then holds up a green capsule and smiles alongside several other colorful balls.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic male voice and upbeat, high-tempo pop BGM. The speaker's pitch is high and delivery is rapid, setting a promotional tone immediately. (2) As the man gestures inside the store, the BGM continues with a driving beat. The vocal volume remains high and consistent, with clear articulation and high emotional arousal. (3) A distinct liquid splashing sound occurs when water is poured on the sofa, followed by the soft friction of fabric being wiped. The BGM remains steady in the background mix. (4) A loud, low-frequency percussive thud sounds as the speaker jumps onto the mattress, emphasizing physical impact and comfort. (5) Sharp, high-frequency mechanical clicks and slides are heard as the wardrobe doors move and wood samples are tapped against each other. (6) A rhythmic gear-turning mechanical sound signals the operation of the gashapon machine, followed by a plastic thud as the capsule hits the delivery tray.
